What we treat

We've got you covered

As home or business owners, at some point we all deal with ants, wasps, spiders, bed bugs, rats, mice, moles, raccoons, and other pests. Here is how we handle them.

Ants & Spiders

Persistent ants, freakish spiders — we listen to your concerns, then eliminate the current problem and prevent the next one.

Wasps & Stinging Pests

Wasps around the eaves, the deck, the kids' play area — handled quickly and safely by salaried professionals.

Rats & Mice

Rodents in a crawl space or attic are a worry no one needs. We remove them and help keep them out for good.

Moles & Small Wildlife

Moles, raccoons, and other small wildlife — dealt with humanely and effectively, with prevention built in.

Bed Bugs

Bed bugs steal sleep and peace of mind. We inspect, treat, and follow up until your home is yours again.

Integrated Pest Management

Proactive, not reactive

Our IPM solutions are tailored to meet the needs of each individual customer and the requirements of the pest. Preventative measures are highlighted at every job.

01Inspection

A detailed inspection of your home or business — what is there, and how it got in.

02Identification

We identify the pest and the conditions attracting it before treating anything.

03Prevention

Prevention is built into every job — sealing, guidance, and follow-ups that stop the next problem.

04Maintenance

Monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly, or a custom preventative plan — whatever fits the need.

What is ATP?

A small, family-owned business — customers first, not shareholders

We are a local, family-owned, small business. Our customers, quality of work, and reputation come first, not shareholders.

Unlike larger companies, we don't send 100% commission-driven, high-pressure salespeople to your door unannounced. Our folks are salaried professionals, only concerned about providing quality pest solutions.
